controls.cppcheck: null pointer and out-of-bounds positives, clean negative; exact source locations/severity/CWE checked
controls.capstone: aligned and misaligned direct branches, truncated bytes; signed targets checked independently
controls.owned_input: Census Geth helper entrypoint and startup bytes; decoded instruction spans independently matched with GNU objdump

capability_limits: C diagnostics validated on owned controls, not a general C/C++ precision benchmark.
Capstone decodes bounded native byte windows and does not execute them or discover arbitrary vulnerabilities.
Single host replay; no independent host or full transitive runtime certification.
